qu-summer-research-internship-program-20.about:
SRIP is Qatar University's flagship summer research programme run by the Young Scientists Center. The 2026 (8th) cycle ran from 24 May to 31 August 2026 with four tracks: Outcomes-directed Research (projects led by QU faculty with defined outputs), Research Skills Advancement (lab techniques, data analysis, ethics and CITI training), a new Researchers Launchpad track in which senior student researchers mentor pre-university learners, and an Industry Training track with placements at leading companies. All participants start with a research methodology course.

It is open to undergraduate and graduate students from QU and other universities; in 2026 the student registration deadline was 30 April. The 9th cycle is expected in summer 2027.
highlights: Real research projects with QU faculty
qu-summer-research-internship-program-20.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students from Qatar University and other universities; pre-university students through the Launchpad track.
how_to_apply: Watch the QUYSC internship page from early 2027
Pick a track and project
Register as a student before the deadline (30 April in 2026)
Attend the inaugural event and methodology course

qu-ysc-stem-workshops.about:
The Qatar University Young Scientists Center (QUYSC) runs fee-based STEM courses alongside its free research programmes. The Arduino course (grades 7-9) teaches circuits, ultrasonic sensors, servo motors and temperature/humidity sensors through projects such as an Arduino traffic-light system; other courses cover basic electronic components and circuits, digital electronics and logic gates, 'Think Like Newton' and 'The Little Scientist' for younger pupils. Some courses are delivered online.

Courses are taught by QUYSC researchers, scientists and engineers; students who complete a course receive a certificate from the centre. Fees are around QAR 300 per student; registration is by email to the course tutor listed on the workshops page.
qu-ysc-stem-workshops.eligibility: School students in Qatar; each course lists its grade range (e.g., Arduino for grades 7-9).
how_to_apply: Open the QUYSC fee-based workshops page
Choose a course for your grade
Register by emailing or calling the listed tutor
Pay the course fee
qu-ysc-stem-workshops.costs: About QAR 300 per student per course.

reboot01-ai-generalist-workshop.about:
Reboot01, Bahrain's coding institute, runs the AI Generalist Workshop for people who want to apply AI in their everyday work without becoming engineers. Over three days (five hours a day) in Seef, participants learn to use AI tools, automate routine tasks and find a practical starting direction in AI.

It is aimed at Bahraini nationals aged 18+ who are currently employed; participants bring their own laptop. The certificate is accredited by Bahrain's Ministry of Labour, and Reboot01 lists Tamkeen as a partner.

Cohorts run on a rolling basis; apply through the 'Join Now' button.
reboot01-ai-generalist-workshop.eligibility: Bahraini nationals aged 18+ who are currently employed; bring a laptop.
how_to_apply: Open the AI Generalist page on reboot01.com
Click Join Now and complete the application
Confirm your cohort dates with Reboot01
reboot01-ai-generalist-workshop.costs: Fee not published (Tamkeen is listed as a partner; ask Reboot01 about support).

sheraa-startup-blueprint.about:
Startup Blueprint is Sheraa's entry-level programme for people who want to turn an idea into a business. It is delivered online (80 lessons, about 2.5 hours of video) with a hybrid community layer of in-person meetups and AMA sessions with mentors in Sharjah.

Twelve chapters cover problem definition, design thinking and Lean Canvas, legal basics, startup finance and cap tables, market sizing, fundraising, founder leadership, hiring, MVP and product, sales and customer discovery, marketing and pitching. Quizzes run throughout and completers receive a certificate.

It is free and open to anyone; graduates are evaluated for a validation bootcamp and Sheraa's Sharjah Startup Studio (S3) accelerator.
highlights: Covers the full path from idea to pitch
sheraa-startup-blueprint.eligibility: Open to students and aspiring founders of any nationality; no prerequisites listed.
how_to_apply: Open the Startup Blueprint course page
Fill in the enrolment / next-cohort form
Complete the 12 chapters and quizzes
Join community meetups and apply onwards to S3 if eligible

sorbonne-abu-dhabi-scholarships-2027.about:
Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi delivers degrees of Sorbonne University (Paris) in the UAE, in fields such as law, economics and management, history and international relations, philosophy, sociology, mathematics and physics, taught in French and English.

Scholarships based on academic excellence or individual circumstances are offered to both undergraduate and postgraduate students, and preferential tuition rates are available across all programmes. A University Scholarship Committee reviews complete applications; newly admitted students apply at registration, and continuing students apply each semester. Awards are limited, so early applications in the first round are strongly encouraged.
highlights: Merit- and need-based awards for all nationalities
Preferential tuition rates on every programme
sorbonne-abu-dhabi-scholarships-2027.eligibility: Newly admitted and continuing undergraduate and postgraduate students at Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi, of any nationality, meeting the published eligibility criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi.
At registration, submit the online scholarship application with supporting documents.
Submit no later than 7 days before the Scholarship Committee meeting (first round recommended).
If awarded, pay the remaining fee or confirm an instalment plan within 20 days.
sorbonne-abu-dhabi-scholarships-2027.costs: Partial scholarships and preferential rates on tuition (amount set by the committee).

squ-gcc-countries-scholarships-2027.about:
Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) in Muscat runs a GCC Countries Scholarships Program with two tracks. Through Embassies: GCC governments nominate their citizens for SQU seats under Gulf cooperation agreements. Through HEAC: GCC students who completed Grade 12 at an Omani school or an international school in Oman apply via the Higher Education Admission Centre, using the admission criteria in HEAC's GCC guidebook.

SQU is Oman's top public university with colleges of medicine, engineering, science, agriculture, economics and political science, law, education and arts.
highlights: Scholarship seats reserved for GCC nationals
Embassy nomination or central HEAC application
squ-gcc-countries-scholarships-2027.eligibility: Citizens of GCC countries: nominated by their governments/embassies, or GCC nationals who completed Grade 12 in Oman (HEAC route), meeting SQU admission criteria.
how_to_apply: GCC students abroad: ask your Ministry of Education or your embassy in Muscat about SQU nominations.
GCC students schooled in Oman: apply through HEAC (heac.gov.om) during its admission window, following the GCC guidebook.
Submit school certificates and identity documents as required.
Accept the SQU offer and scholarship.
squ-gcc-countries-scholarships-2027.costs: Scholarship for undergraduate study at SQU under the GCC programme (tuition and benefits per agreement).

stars-of-science-season-19.about:
Stars of Science is QF's flagship innovation platform, produced by Qatar Science & Technology Park. Selected innovators develop their idea into a prototype and venture with engineering, design and business mentoring, competing in a televised series watched across the Arab world. From season 18 the format puts more weight on venture-building, AI and emerging technologies.

Applications are open to entrepreneurs, engineers, scientists, designers and creators aged 18-35 from across the Arab world and the global Arab diaspora, working in fields such as AI, gaming, robotics, climate, health-tech, fashion-tech and engineering. Season 18 applications ran from 9 to 26 June 2026; the next call is expected in a similar window in 2027.

The winner receives a supported venture-building experience in Qatar: mentorship, office space, operational support and access to interns.
highlights: Pan-Arab TV exposure for your invention
Mentoring from engineers, designers and investors
Winner gets venture-building support in Qatar
stars-of-science-season-19.eligibility: Arab nationals and members of the Arab diaspora aged 18-35, with an innovative idea in science or technology.
how_to_apply: Follow QSTP and Stars of Science for the 2027 call (expected June)
Prepare a short description and video of your idea
Submit the online application in the open window
Attend selection interviews if shortlisted
stars-of-science-season-19.costs: Free to apply; participation and mentoring are covered by the organisers.

steam-champions-uae-2026-2027.about:
STEAM Champions UAE is a season-long challenge run by Dubai-based EduStream, registered on the UN SDG partnership platform (no UN endorsement implied). The 2026/27 theme is Circular Futures (SDG 12), with 12 options across AI, Robotics & Drones (KG–Grade 9), a Circular Futures Innovation & Venture Challenge (KG–Grade 12) and a Circular Stories Creative Challenge (ages 10–18).

Teams of one to four students enter via schools, clubs, families or a Global Online Division. The online qualification deadline is 20 February 2027, international judging is on 13 March, and the National Championship & Expo is in Dubai on 20 March 2027, with possible international pathways later in 2027.

Fees are AED 100 per student for live UAE participation (USD 30 per team online). Registration closes 31 October 2026.
highlights: AI, robotics, drones, venture and storytelling options
Teams of 1–4 from KG to Grade 12
National championship and expo in Dubai
steam-champions-uae-2026-2027.eligibility: Students aged 4–18 (KG–Grade 12) via school, club, family or online teams.
how_to_apply: Pick one option per student
Submit one registration form per school or organisation by 31 October 2026
Coach completes the free Level 1 certification
Submit the online qualification by 20 February 2027
steam-champions-uae-2026-2027.costs: AED 100 per student (UAE live) or USD 30 per team (online division).

tasmu-accelerator-2027.about:
The TASMU Accelerator was launched by MCIT as part of the TASMU Smart Qatar programme to help tech startups bring their solutions to the Qatari market. The 2026 (fourth) cohort focused on transportation and logistics, healthcare, environment and smart cities, with registration from March to May 2026, screening in June, pre-acceleration in June-July and acceleration from July to December, followed by a support programme.

Startups receive mentoring, partner access and help to pilot and scale in Qatar. The next cohort is expected to follow the same yearly timeline; interested founders can register to stay in touch through the accelerator's F6S page.
highlights: Government-backed route into the Qatari market
tasmu-accelerator-2027.eligibility: Tech startups (local and international) with solutions for Qatar's smart-city priorities. University founders with a working product can apply.
how_to_apply: Register interest on the accelerator's F6S page
Apply when registration opens (around March 2027)
Pass screening and join pre-acceleration

uaeu-chancellors-graduate-merit-fellowsh.about:
The Chancellor's Fellowship for Graduate Students (master's and doctoral) aims to attract excellent students to UAEU. Its Merit Fellowship Award for Newly Admitted Students gives a partial tuition waiver of 50% to applicants with excellent academic standing (GPA ≥ 3.8/4.0), primarily in STEM and strategic areas; it does not apply to education programmes or the DBA.

The award stays valid until graduation as long as the student keeps a GPA of 3.8 or more. A separate Merit Fellowship exists for high-achieving continuing students, and UAEU also offers research, teaching and administrative assistantships to all nationalities.
uaeu-chancellors-graduate-merit-fellowsh.eligibility: Newly admitted UAEU master's/doctoral students of any nationality with GPA ≥ 3.8/4.0 (primarily STEM/strategic programmes; excludes education programmes and DBA), subject to budget.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to a UAEU graduate programme for Fall 2027.
Apply for the Chancellor's Merit Fellowship before the admission deadline.
Maintain GPA ≥ 3.8 to keep the award.

uaeu-phd-fellowship-all-nationalities-20.about:
UAEU, the country's first national university in Al Ain, recruits high-achieving doctoral students in certain majors through its PhD Fellowship (All Nationalities). Awards are competitive and consider GPA, publications, conference presentations, patents, GRE scores, recommendation letters and the applicant's previous university.

The Full Package includes a full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend, health insurance and up to AED 3,000 (external project) or AED 2,000 (internal project) from the supervisor's research grant; fellows commit to 40 hours a week on study/research plus 5–10 hours of teaching or administrative assistance. A Basic Package (tuition waiver and insurance, with optional paid assistant work up to AED 4,000) is also offered. UAEU also has research, teaching and administrative assistantships open to all nationalities, and a 50% Chancellor's Merit Fellowship for graduate entrants with GPA ≥ 3.8.
highlights: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend + insurance
Priority research areas: energy, transport, health, water, tech, space
uaeu-phd-fellowship-all-nationalities-20.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality with a master's GPA ≥ 3.3/4.0, no employment or other sponsorship, a dissertation in a UAE priority sector, meeting UAEU PhD admission requirements.
how_to_apply: Pick a UAEU PhD programme and potential supervisor.
Complete the UAEU graduate admission application before the Fall 2027 deadline.
Submit copies of all credentials (GPA, publications, GRE, recommendations) with the application.
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed; fellows sign the fellowship terms.
uaeu-phd-fellowship-all-nationalities-20.costs: Full Package: tuition waiver, monthly stipend, health insurance, up to AED 3,000/2,000 monthly top-up from supervisor's project. Basic Package: tuition waiver, insurance, optional assistant work up to AED 4,000.

udst-ai-software-engineering-winter-scho.about:
The AI-SE Winter School at UDST fosters interdisciplinary knowledge exchange, networking and collaboration on frontier topics in artificial intelligence and software engineering and how they overlap. Sessions are led by international and UDST faculty and researchers, combining talks with focused workshops and presentations designed to strengthen students' research skills.

The school has run in previous years (the 2026 edition was held in January 2026 with a published agenda and transport schedule). Registration is through UDST's online form, where students upload a valid student card; the next edition is expected in early 2027.
highlights: Workshops aimed at student research skills
udst-ai-software-engineering-winter-scho.eligibility: University students (with valid student ID), researchers and professionals.
how_to_apply: Check the AI-SE Winter School page for 2027 dates and agenda
Complete the online registration form
Upload your student card if registering as a student
udst-ai-software-engineering-winter-scho.costs: Not stated; registration via UDST form.

udst-dynamic-futures-qatar-eaa-scholarsh.about:
Dynamic Futures Qatar (DFQ) is a scholarship from the Education Above All (EAA) Foundation, through its Al Fakhoora programme, for expatriate youth living in Qatar who are about to start or are early in their studies at UDST. It prioritises degrees aligned with Qatar's future labour-market needs; orphans and applicants with special needs receive additional consideration.

Selection combines a financial analysis of household income and expenses with EAA student assessments. Only first- and second-year students qualify, and Foundation Program students are excluded.
highlights: Need-based funding for long-term expatriate residents of Qatar
Run by Education Above All's Al Fakhoora programme
Extra consideration for orphans and students with special needs
udst-dynamic-futures-qatar-eaa-scholarsh.eligibility: Legal residents of Qatar (valid residency permit) aged 16–27 who have studied in Qatar for at least 8 years, with a minimum 85% high-school average (new Fall entrants) or GPA 3.0 (continuing students), enrolled in the Fall semester in an eligible programme, not receiving other education support, and with family income under the EAA threshold (QAR 12,000 family cap on the scorecard). International (non-resident) students are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to UDST for Fall 2027.
Watch for the DFQ announcement from UDST's Admission and Registration Department in the Fall semester.
Apply directly to UDST and submit household income and expense documents from the checklist.
Complete EAA's selection assessments; successful applicants are contacted by UDST.
udst-dynamic-futures-qatar-eaa-scholarsh.costs: Scholarship support for tuition and study costs per EAA's award terms.

udst-graduate-sponsorship-research-award.about:
The Graduate Sponsorship Research Award (GSRA) at the University of Doha for Science and Technology nurtures future faculty and researchers. It has a local track and an international track, and supports students joining UDST's full-time graduate programmes, ideally building on their bachelor's capstone project.

It covers full tuition for up to 2 years (master's) or 4 years (PhD), up to QAR 18,000 per year for conferences and, for international awardees, health insurance, a settlement allowance and an annual air ticket.
highlights: Full tuition for master's (2 yrs) or PhD (4 yrs)
International track with insurance, settlement allowance and flights
udst-graduate-sponsorship-research-award.eligibility: Applicants under 40 at the deadline who are accepted into, or applying for, a full-time UDST graduate programme starting the next academic year. Local and international tracks.
how_to_apply: Choose a UDST master's or PhD programme and identify a research supervisor.
Prepare a proposal building on your capstone/research project.
Submit the GSRA application before the April deadline (research office vetting follows a week later).
Contact UDST Applied Research and Graduate Studies for the current call.
udst-graduate-sponsorship-research-award.costs: Full tuition; conference allowance up to QAR 18,000/year; health insurance, settlement allowance and annual air ticket for international awardees.

udst-jassim-hamad-bin-jassim-foundation-.about:
The Jassim and Hamad Bin Jassim Charitable Foundation funds two programmes for UDST bachelor's students. The Non-Qatari Student Support Program covers tuition fees only, up to QAR 10,000 per semester, for students with a cumulative GPA of 3.0+ and per-capita family income under QR 1,000 (after loans and rent). The Rewards Program pays QR 5,000 per semester to Qatari students with GPA 3.5+ and per-capita family income under QR 6,000.

Aid can be received for multiple semesters within the study plan, once per academic year. Applications are made through UDST Student Self Service with salary certificates, bank statements and a credit bureau report.
highlights: Up to QAR 10,000/semester tuition aid for non-Qatari students
QR 5,000/semester rewards for high-achieving Qatari students
udst-jassim-hamad-bin-jassim-foundation-.eligibility: Actively enrolled UDST bachelor's students. Non-Qatari: GPA ≥ 3.0 and per-capita family income ≤ QR 1,000. Qatari Rewards: GPA ≥ 3.5 and per-capita family income ≤ QR 6,000.
how_to_apply: Enrol at UDST.
Gather consent form, IDs, guardian's salary certificate, 6 months of bank statements, Qatar Credit Bureau report, debt certificate, employment/rental contracts.
Submit the financial aid application in Student Self Service before the semester deadline.
Respond to any Foundation verification requests.
udst-jassim-hamad-bin-jassim-foundation-.costs: Non-Qatari: tuition up to QAR 10,000 per semester (not summer). Qatari: QR 5,000 per semester.

udst-varsity-sports-scholarship-2027.about:
The UDST Varsity Sports Scholarship supports dedicated athletes who show exceptional talent in one of the sports listed by the university (individual sports outside the list are not currently considered). Winners receive full tuition exemption, a monthly allowance, priority registration and dedicated academic and athletic support while playing for UDST's varsity teams.

Selection looks at sporting excellence and a minimum C+ (78% or GPA 2.0) high-school record, a sports CV, video footage, coach letters, a statement, medical records, international clearances where needed, and a final interview.
highlights: For athletes in UDST's listed varsity sports
Applied university in Doha with industry links
udst-varsity-sports-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Applicants admitted to UDST with proven excellence in a listed sport and at least C+ (78%/2.0 GPA) in high school. Check UDST for nationality rules.
how_to_apply: Apply for UDST admission for Fall 2027.
Prepare a sports CV, video footage, coach letters, statement and medical records.
Submit the varsity scholarship application to UDST Sport and Varsity.
Attend the final interview.
udst-varsity-sports-scholarship-2027.costs: Full tuition exemption plus a monthly allowance.

vcuarts-qatar-community-education-2026-2.about:
VCUarts Qatar's Community Education Program offers non-credit art and design courses taught by artists and designers on the Education City campus. Fall 2026 offers Social Media Design & Branding (2 Nov-7 Dec, ages 16+), Communication Skills for Young Creatives (4 Nov-2 Dec) and the online Portfolio Development Class E; an early-spring New Year's programme in January 2027 includes linocut, journaling and Illustrator tasters; Spring 2027 (March-April) includes Islamic pattern construction, architectural drawing, Adobe Illustrator, smartphone videography, character design and linocut.

The courses suit high school students building an art or design portfolio and anyone exploring creative fields. Registration and payment are online.
highlights: Taught at a top-ranked US art school's Qatar campus
Portfolio-building courses for future art students
vcuarts-qatar-community-education-2026-2.eligibility: Teens and adults in Qatar; some courses specify ages (e.g., 16+).
how_to_apply: Browse the Community Education course list
Check the age requirement for your course
Register and pay online
Attend classes in Education City
vcuarts-qatar-community-education-2026-2.costs: Course fees vary; see each course page.

wcmq-biomedical-research-training-progra.about:
WCM-Q's Biomedical Research Training Program prepares recent university graduates for careers in biomedical research. Trainees choose an applied track (wet-lab bench science, clinical research such as recruitment and study design, or research administration for those without lab background) and receive training in data analysis and statistics, clinical research, research compliance, lab management and grants administration. WCM-Q research focuses on diabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, cardiovascular complications and neurological conditions.

The 2026 application window has closed; WCM-Q invites interested graduates to register to be notified when the 2027 cycle opens.
highlights: Ten months inside a Cornell-affiliated research institution
Choice of lab, clinical or research-administration track
Training in statistics and research compliance
wcmq-biomedical-research-training-progra.eligibility: Recent university graduates who are Qatari nationals or long-term residents of Qatar.
how_to_apply: Register your interest via the WCM-Q student-interest form
Apply online when the 2027 cycle opens
Attend interviews if shortlisted
wcmq-biomedical-research-training-progra.costs: No tuition; contact WCM-Q (brtp@qatar-med.cornell.edu) for stipend details.

world-scholars-cup-dubai-march-round-202.about:
The World Scholar's Cup (WSC) is an international academic tournament for school students built around a yearly interdisciplinary theme. The Dubai March Round runs 27–29 March 2027, with days 1–2 at Sunmarke School and day 3 at Arcadia Global School.

Teams of three compete in team debate, collaborative writing, the Scholar's Challenge (individual multiple-choice) and the Scholar's Bowl quiz, followed by awards and social events. Students compete in Junior or Senior divisions and can qualify for a Global Round and then the Tournament of Champions at Yale University.

Any school student can take part; schools usually register teams, but independent teams are accepted. Fees are set per round and shown in the WSC registration system.
highlights: Debate, writing, quiz and Scholar's Challenge in one event
Qualification path to Global Rounds and the Tournament of Champions at Yale
world-scholars-cup-dubai-march-round-202.eligibility: School students of any nationality in the Junior or Senior division age bands set by WSC; teams of three (schools or independent teams).
how_to_apply: Open the Dubai March Round page on scholarscup.org
Request information or log in to the WSC registration system
Form a team of three and register for the round
Pay the round fee and study the year's curriculum
world-scholars-cup-dubai-march-round-202.costs: Registration fee per student set by WSC for the round (see registration system); travel and accommodation at participants' own cost.

world-scholars-cup-dubai-may-round-2027.about:
The Dubai May Round of the World Scholar's Cup takes place 29–31 May 2027 at Sunmarke School and Arcadia Global School. It follows the same format as every WSC round and uses the current season's interdisciplinary curriculum.

Teams of three take part in team debate, collaborative writing, the individual Scholar's Challenge and the Scholar's Bowl, with awards ceremonies and a scholar's ball. Results can qualify students for a summer Global Round and then the Tournament of Champions at Yale.

It suits students who missed the March round or want a second attempt at qualification. Registration and fees are handled through the WSC registration system.
highlights: Late-season chance to qualify for the Global Round
Interdisciplinary curriculum covering science, history, art and more
Welcoming to new and returning teams
world-scholars-cup-dubai-may-round-2027.eligibility: School students in WSC Junior or Senior divisions, any nationality; teams of three.
how_to_apply: Open the WSC calendar and choose the Dubai May Round
Request info or log in to registration.scholarscup.org
Register your team of three and pay the fee
Prepare using the season's curriculum guide
world-scholars-cup-dubai-may-round-2027.costs: Per-student round fee set by WSC; travel and accommodation not included.

y4s-future-sustainability-leaders-2027.about:
Future Sustainability Leaders (FSL) is the university and young-professional track of Masdar's Youth 4 Sustainability platform. It lasts 12 months and starts each January at Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week (ADSW), followed by online and in-person activities through the year.

Participants get one-to-one mentoring, Talent Connect career dialogues with internship and entry-level pathways, access to the Y4S Annual Forum & Hub and Sustainability Leadership Series, and the Out-of-Labs innovation challenge. Any major is welcome.

The programme is free. It is open to UAE nationals and international students aged 19–35 who hold or are pursuing an undergraduate degree and speak excellent English; living in the UAE is not required, and the programme has accepted participants from many countries. Apply with a video, personal statement and short questions by 30 November.
highlights: Free and open to international applicants
One-to-one mentorship and Talent Connect career pathways
Starts at Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week
y4s-future-sustainability-leaders-2027.eligibility: Aged 19–35; UAE nationals or international students holding or pursuing an undergraduate degree at an accredited institution (any major); excellent spoken English. UAE residence not required, but attendance at ADSW and all virtual series is expected.
how_to_apply: Read the FSL page on y4s.ae
Register on the FSL portal
Upload a short video and a personal statement
Answer the personal questions and submit by 30 November
Selections are announced in January
y4s-future-sustainability-leaders-2027.costs: Free; Y4S never charges participants. Travel to Abu Dhabi for ADSW is not stated as covered.

y4s-sustainability-ambassadors-2027.about:
The Sustainability Ambassadors Program is Masdar's flagship school-age track within Youth 4 Sustainability (Y4S). It runs for 12 months, starting at Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week (ADSW) each January, and mixes online sessions, in-person and virtual events, the Y4S Annual Forum & Hub and the Sustainability Leadership Series.

Ambassadors receive core training on the UN Sustainable Development Goals, gain hands-on experience and networking at major sustainability events, and take part in the Innovation Lab, including Code 4 Climate, a two-day hackathon in which teams build AI-enabled mobile apps that tackle the SDGs. They also represent Y4S in their schools.

The programme is completely free (Y4S states it will never ask participants to pay). It is for UAE nationals or residents aged 15–18 who attend a UAE school and speak excellent English. Applications (video, personal statement and short questions) close on 30 November; selections are announced in January.
highlights: Free, 12-month programme starting at Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week
Code 4 Climate AI app hackathon and Innovation Lab
Networking at the region's largest sustainability events
y4s-sustainability-ambassadors-2027.eligibility: UAE nationals or residents aged 15–18 enrolled in a UAE-based school, with excellent spoken English and a genuine interest in sustainability. Must commit to attending all series and events, including ADSW.
how_to_apply: Open the Sustainability Ambassadors page on y4s.ae
Register on the Y4S portal
Record and upload a short video
Write a personal statement on why you want to join and answer the personal questions
Submit before 30 November and wait for January selection results
y4s-sustainability-ambassadors-2027.costs: Free. No fees of any kind; participants attend events in Abu Dhabi.

yec-qatar-young-entrepreneurs-club.about:
The Young Entrepreneurs Club (YEC) is a non-profit youth organisation founded in 2022 and listed among the Ministry of Sports and Youth's youth bodies. It gives young people in Qatar independent information on investment and entrepreneurship and helps them start commercial and social ventures.

Membership benefits include local workshops, seminars and discussion groups (including an annual entrepreneurship forum), an annual market publication, contact with business leaders and institutions, and specialised courses from beginner to advanced level. YEC also partners with QSTP, for example on the QSTP x YEC Summer Bootcamp. Some events require membership to book.
how_to_apply: Create an account on yec.qa
Complete membership registration
Book workshops and events through the site
yec-qatar-young-entrepreneurs-club.costs: Membership terms on the YEC website.

zayed-university-international-merit-sch.about:
Zayed University, a federal UAE university with campuses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, offers limited scholarships to self-funding international undergraduates (tuition AED 2,500 per credit hour). The President's Award covers full tuition (e.g. 97% American/MOE, A*A British, IB 42, CBSE 95%, plus EmSAT Maths 1100 or SAT Maths 650); Academic Merit Scholarships cover 50% (90%, IB 36, SAT Maths 590) or 25% (85%, IB 33).

Submit the scholarship form with documents and a reference letter from your latest school by the published date; awards are made at the start of each Fall and Spring semester, and must be kept with a CGPA of 3.6 (President's) or 3.3 (Merit).
zayed-university-international-merit-sch.eligibility: Self-funding international students admitted to Zayed University bachelor's programmes with high school results, a maths test (EmSAT/SAT) and three years of extracurriculars.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to Zayed University
Submit the scholarship form, transcripts, maths test score and a school reference letter by the published deadline
Award confirmed at the start of the semester
zayed-university-international-merit-sch.costs: 100%, 50% or 25% of tuition; housing, food, laptop and transport not covered.

aberdeen-global-scholarship-undergraduat.about:
Aberdeen, one of Scotland's ancient universities, offers the Aberdeen Global Scholarship of £6,000 per year (deducted from tuition) to all new self-funded, full-time, on-campus international undergraduates starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28. Scottish degrees usually last four years, so this can be worth about £24,000.

There is no nationality restriction (Georgia and Qatar included). Students who are fully sponsored or hold fully funded external scholarships or other Aberdeen awards are not eligible. Only the Aberdeen campus qualifies.
aberdeen-global-scholarship-undergraduat.eligibility: New self-funded, full-time, on-campus international-fee undergraduates starting in 2027/28 (not fully sponsored).
how_to_apply: Apply for your undergraduate course via UCAS.
Accept your offer; the scholarship is applied automatically and shown on your CAS.
aberdeen-global-scholarship-undergraduat.costs: £6,000 tuition fee waiver each year of the programme.

adelaide-academic-excellence-scholarship.about:
Adelaide University (formed by the merger of the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia) offers the Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship: a 50% tuition fee reduction for international students starting a CRICOS-registered bachelor's degree, for the full duration, subject to keeping a GPA of 5.5/7. It requires an ATAR of 99 or international equivalent.

Apply with the scholarship application form (SATAC applicants use a separate version). A selection panel assesses applications on merit on a rolling basis until allocations are exhausted. If you narrowly miss it, the university also automatically awards 25% (Emerging Leaders, distinction average) and 15% (Merit, credit average) tuition reductions.
highlights: 50% tuition reduction for the whole degree
adelaide-academic-excellence-scholarship.eligibility: International students applying for an eligible bachelor's degree with ATAR 99 or international equivalent. Excludes Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine and some health degrees; not for Australia Awards or fully sponsored students.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible Adelaide University bachelor's programme
Complete the Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship application form
Selection panel reviews on a rolling basis
Scholarship is added to your offer of admission
adelaide-academic-excellence-scholarship.costs: 50% of tuition fees each year (international bachelor's tuition roughly A$40,000-50,000/year).

alu-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.about:
African Leadership University (ALU) in Kigali, Rwanda, runs mission-driven bachelor's degrees: BSc (Hons) Software Engineering, Entrepreneurial Leadership, and International Business & Trade. Through its partnership with the Mastercard Foundation it offers full scholarships to promising young leaders from across Africa who face financial adversity, with emphasis on young women, refugees and young people with disabilities.

Apply through ALU's online application (the January 2027 intake closes 30 Nov 2026; the September 2027 intake follows) and indicate that you need financial support. Follow ALU's Admissions Application Guide, which explains the scholarship steps.
highlights: Full scholarship for African students with financial need
Degrees in software engineering, entrepreneurship, international business
alu-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.eligibility: Young Africans (citizens of African countries) facing economic hardship, with leadership potential and a commitment to giving back. Priority for young women, refugees, displaced youth and people with disabilities.
how_to_apply: Read ALU's Admissions Application Guide
Submit the ALU application by 30 Nov 2026 (January 2027 intake) or the later September 2027 deadline
Indicate financial need and complete scholarship questions
Take part in any assessments or interviews
alu-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.costs: Full scholarship (tuition and support costs as defined by the Mastercard Foundation programme).

american-university-of-paris-undergradua.about:
The American University of Paris is an English-language liberal arts university in central Paris with students from over 100 countries. It awards more than €6 million every year; around 50% of students receive financial aid, in some cases as high as 75% of tuition, as tuition abatements.

Merit awards and scholarships (including automatic IB Diploma scholarships) are based on your profile and are considered automatically at admission. Need-based Tuition Awards combine your admission file with a financial aid application documenting family need. All nationalities are eligible, including Georgia and Qatar. Awards are renewable if you keep the required GPA.
highlights: ~50% of students get aid; up to 75% of tuition
English-taught liberal arts in central Paris
american-university-of-paris-undergradua.eligibility: First-year undergraduate degree applicants of any nationality. Need-based awards require a complete financial aid application; visiting/first-year-abroad students are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to AUP (Fall 2027).
You are automatically considered for merit awards at admission.
For need-based aid, complete the tuition award application and financial documents.
Respond to your award letter by the date stated on it.
american-university-of-paris-undergradua.costs: Tuition abatements from merit and need-based awards, up to about 75% of tuition in some cases.

amsterdam-university-college-asf-scholar.about:
Amsterdam University College (AUC) is the English-taught liberal arts and sciences bachelor's college run jointly by the University of Amsterdam and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Its AUC Scholarship Fund (ASF) offers ASF Scholarships (need-based) and Talent Fellowships to AUC students.

All 2025-26 funding has been awarded; applications are scheduled to reopen in January 2027 with updated criteria. ASF Scholarships are only awarded to AUC students, so apply to AUC first. Non-EEA applicants can also look at the NL Scholarship.
amsterdam-university-college-asf-scholar.eligibility: Admitted or current AUC students; detailed criteria for new ASF Scholarships will be published when applications reopen in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to AUC's Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Watch the ASF page for the January 2027 opening.
Submit the ASF application form with the requested financial information.
amsterdam-university-college-asf-scholar.costs: Partial tuition/living support; amounts published with the 2027 round.

anglo-american-university-first-year-hon.about:
Anglo-American University (AAU) is a private, English-language university in central Prague offering US-accredited bachelor's degrees in business, international relations, journalism, law, humanities and more. Its First-Year Honors Scholarship rewards outstanding new undergraduates on prior academic achievement plus English proficiency.

The 50% level needs e.g. GPA 3.8, IB 34, A-levels AAB or AP 5-5-4, plus IELTS 8.0 / SAT ERW 700; the 30% level needs GPA 3.5, IB 32, A-levels ABB, plus IELTS 7.0 / SAT ERW 650. The discount applies to a portion of first-year tuition (upfront or 10% per semester). Any nationality can qualify.
highlights: 30% or 50% off part of first-year tuition
anglo-american-university-first-year-hon.eligibility: New first-year undergraduates at AAU meeting both an academic threshold (GPA/IB/A-level/AP/Maturita) and an English proficiency threshold.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to AAU for Fall 2027.
Submit transcripts and an English test (IELTS, TOEFL, CAE, SAT ERW, etc.).
If you meet the thresholds, the honors scholarship is applied to your tuition.
anglo-american-university-first-year-hon.costs: 30% or 50% discount on a portion of tuition in the first year (not redeemable in cash).

armenia-government-scholarship-georgia-i.about:
Under the March 2023 memorandum between the education ministries of Georgia and Armenia, Armenia funds master's study for Georgian citizens at partner universities, in any academic field. Georgia's International Education Center collects applications and nominates candidates.

The programme is useful for students who want an affordable regional master's degree close to home, with study possible in Armenian, Russian or English depending on the university.
highlights: Master's in any field at Armenian partner universities
armenia-government-scholarship-georgia-i.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) holding a bachelor's degree.
how_to_apply: Check iec.gov.ge in April 2027 for the new call.
Choose a programme at one of the partner universities listed in the call.
Prepare CV, motivation letter, diploma and transcript, recommendation and passport copy.
Send the application to info-iec@iec.gov.ge before the deadline.
armenia-government-scholarship-georgia-i.costs: Tuition waiver and support under the bilateral memorandum; see the call for stipend and housing terms.

aston-international-community-scholarshi.about:
Aston University's International Community Scholarship (Undergraduate) for September 2027 is a competitive, application-based award worth £9,000: a £3,000 tuition discount in each of years 1–3 (years 2 and 3 awarded automatically on progression; not in placement years).

It is for self-funded international offer-holders entering Year 1 of a full-time on-campus degree; Nursing, Medicine, Optometry, Pharmacy and Audiology are excluded. The application link is emailed to eligible offer-holders. Aston's top award, the Sir Adrian Cadbury Chancellor's Scholarship, is listed separately.
highlights: Application link emailed to offer holders
aston-international-community-scholarshi.eligibility: Self-funded international offer-holders entering Year 1 of an eligible full-time on-campus undergraduate degree in September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Wait for the scholarship application link emailed after your offer (contact hello@aston.ac.uk if missing).
Submit in the early or final round; pay the deposit within 21/14 days if awarded.
aston-international-community-scholarshi.costs: £3,000 tuition fee discount per year for years 1–3.

aston-sir-adrian-cadbury-chancellors-sch.about:
Named after Aston's former Chancellor, the Sir Adrian Cadbury Chancellor's Scholarship is a £10,000 tuition fee reduction for self-funded international undergraduate offer-holders starting in September 2027.

After your offer you receive a personal application link; you submit a form and a 500-word statement (450–550 words) on how you will make a positive impact and use your degree to support communities. Nursing, Medicine, Optometry, Pharmacy and Audiology are excluded. Aston scholarships cannot be combined; you get the highest one you qualify for.
aston-sir-adrian-cadbury-chancellors-sch.eligibility: Self-funded international undergraduate offer-holders for September 2027 (excluded: Nursing, Medicine, Optometry, Pharmacy, Audiology).
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Use the personal application link emailed after your offer.
Submit the form and a 500-word statement (between 450 and 550 words).

aubg-bachelor-scholarships-financial-aid.about:
AUBG is an American-style liberal arts university in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria, accredited in the US and EU, with English-taught majors in business, economics, computer science, journalism, political science and more. It attracts many students from the Balkans, the Black Sea region, Central Asia and beyond.

Priority applicants (15 January) get the earliest decision and best chance of funding: donor-funded merit-based scholarships (apply by 15 Jan) and donor-funded need-based scholarships (apply by 31 Jan). Students from any country, including Georgia, can apply; awards are combined with AUBG's institutional aid.
highlights: 81% of new students got aid last year
US-accredited liberal arts degree in Europe
aubg-bachelor-scholarships-financial-aid.eligibility: International and Bulgarian applicants to bachelor's programmes for Fall 2027. Need-based aid requires financial documents; merit awards are based on academic record and achievements.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission by the Priority deadline (15 January 2027).
Submit the donor-funded merit scholarship application by 15 January 2027.
Submit the need-based scholarship application with financial documents by 31 January 2027.
Receive your admission and aid package with the earliest decisions.
aubg-bachelor-scholarships-financial-aid.costs: Scholarships and aid reduce tuition by varying amounts; loans and other support also available.

auc-excellence-scholarship-international.about:
The American University in Cairo is an English-language, US-accredited liberal arts university in New Cairo, Egypt. Its Excellence Scholarship Program lets new undergraduates stack several merit categories for a total of 20% to 100% of tuition: Academic Achievement (from 20%, up to 100% for top scorers, automatic), International Diversity (up to 30% for students applying as internationals, automatic), Talents, Leadership and Community Service, and Liberal Arts Majors (each up to 30%, with videos and supporting documents).

Certificate scores are the main criterion (SAT/ACT for American-diploma holders), and financial need is also considered. Apply for admission by 1 Feb 2027 for priority on higher awards, or by 1 Jun 2027 at the latest, submitting the admission, scholarship and financial need assessment applications.
highlights: Automatic International Diversity award up to 30%
auc-excellence-scholarship-international.eligibility: New undergraduate applicants of any nationality for Fall 2027; International Diversity category for students applying as international students. Cut-off scores vary by cohort.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission through the AUC portal by 1 Feb 2027 (early) or 1 Jun 2027
Complete the scholarship application and financial need assessment
For Talents/Leadership/Liberal Arts categories, upload videos and supporting documents
Receive scholarship decision with or after admission
auc-excellence-scholarship-international.costs: 20%-100% tuition waiver; housing and living costs not included unless otherwise stated.

auc-international-graduate-fellowship-fa.about:
The American University in Cairo, Egypt's leading English-language university, runs institutional fellowships for graduate students. The International Graduate Fellowship is open to international students fully admitted to any field of graduate study; other fellowships target African students, refugees, and all nationalities in selected HUSS, business, public affairs (GAPP) and education programmes. International fellowship holders who study full time may also receive a housing allowance.

For Fall 2027 there are two cycles: 22 December 2026–17 January 2027 and 6 April–6 May 2027. Submit your graduate admission application at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline; you do not need an admission decision first. MEng, Master in Computing and diploma students are not eligible.
highlights: Housing allowance for full-time international fellows
Strong in Middle East studies, policy and IR
auc-international-graduate-fellowship-fa.eligibility: International students (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar) fully admitted to an AUC master's or PhD (excluding MEng, Master in Computing and diplomas).
how_to_apply: Submit your AUC graduate admission application at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline
Complete the online fellowship application in cycle 1 (by 17 Jan 2027) or cycle 2 (by 6 May 2027)
Await the fellowship decision with or after admission
auc-international-graduate-fellowship-fa.costs: Tuition coverage (full or partial per fellowship) plus possible housing allowance for full-time international students.

auc-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.about:
The American University in Cairo hosts the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program for talented young Africans. It covers full tuition and fees, a semester stipend, a standard double room in AUC housing (for students from outside Cairo and Giza), a laptop, medical services and health insurance, a bus subscription or travel allowance, intensive English for some, and one return flight a year for students living outside Egypt. Scholars also receive leadership and career support.

Applicants must be citizens of an African country (North Africa included) living in Africa, 2025-2026 high-school graduates (no transfers), meet AUC admission requirements, show high achievement, financial need and extracurricular involvement, and score IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 62 / Duolingo 115. Apply through AUC's application steps for Spring or Fall 2027.
highlights: Full tuition, stipend, housing and flights
For African citizens with financial need
auc-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.eligibility: Citizens of African countries residing in Africa; 2025-2026 high-school graduates; financial need; IELTS 5.5 (writing 5.5) / TOEFL 62 / Duolingo 115.
how_to_apply: Apply to AUC for Spring or Fall 2027 following the Application Steps page
Complete the Mastercard Foundation Scholars application and financial need documents
Submit English test scores
Attend interviews if shortlisted
auc-mastercard-foundation-scholars-2027.costs: Full tuition and fees, stipend, housing, laptop, insurance, transport and annual return airfare.

austria-scholarship-foundation-internati.about:
The Scholarship Foundation of the Republic of Austria funds master's study in the field of International Relations in Austria (for example at the Diplomatic Academy of Vienna or Austrian universities). The scholarships are intended for descendants of forced labourers under the National Socialist regime and for nationals of countries that suffered particularly from that regime, which includes many Central and Eastern European and former Soviet states.

Awards cover nine months and are administered by OeAD. The annual closing date is 1 April.
highlights: Funded IR master's year in Vienna
Targets Central/Eastern Europe and post-Soviet countries
austria-scholarship-foundation-internati.eligibility: Graduates who are descendants of NS-era forced labourers or nationals of countries that suffered particularly from the NS regime (see the current call on grants.at for the list of eligible countries, including whether Georgia is covered). Admission to an IR master's in Austria required.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility in the current call on grants.at
Apply for an International Relations master's in Austria
Submit the scholarship application via grants.at by 1 April 2027
austria-scholarship-foundation-internati.costs: Monthly scholarship for 9 months (rates in the call); tuition arrangements per programme.

bard-college-berlin-ba-financial-aid-202.about:
Bard College Berlin offers four-year BA degrees in humanities, arts and social thought, taught in English in a small residential college. Aid is awarded on demonstrated financial need regardless of nationality: in 2026-27, 82% of undergraduates received BCB aid, with an average scholarship of €15,125 against an average annual cost of €22,572; awards range from €3,000 a year to the full comprehensive fee.

One financial aid application automatically considers you for every scholarship you qualify for. Recipients typically have a predicted IB of 34+, Abitur 1.0–1.5 or US GPA 3.7+. Students from Georgia, Qatar and all countries can apply; prior degree holders are not eligible.
bard-college-berlin-ba-financial-aid-202.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality to the BA or Academy Year with demonstrated financial need; strong academics (e.g. IB 34+). Not for students who already hold a degree.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to the BA (Regular Decision).
Submit the financial aid application with family financial documents by 10 January 2027.
Receive your aid decision in late March 2027.
Pay the deposit by 1 May 2027.
bard-college-berlin-ba-financial-aid-202.costs: Scholarships from €3,000/year up to the full comprehensive fee (tuition + housing); average BCB scholarship €15,125/year.

bath-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.about:
The University of Bath offers up to 250 Bath Global Excellence Scholarships worth £10,000 to high-achieving international students joining a full-time taught master's in September 2027. The award is a tuition fee waiver for courses in the Faculty of Engineering & Design, the Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences and the Faculty of Science (School of Management has its own scholarships).

Awards are based on academic excellence and potential. Register your interest now and apply once the application form opens.
highlights: Engineering, science, humanities and social sciences
Top-10 UK university in many league tables
bath-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.eligibility: International fee-paying applicants (any nationality) to eligible full-time taught master's courses at Bath starting September 2027 with strong academic records.
how_to_apply: Register interest on the Bath scholarship page
Apply for an eligible full-time taught master's
Submit the scholarship application when it opens
bath-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.costs: £10,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

brown-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Brown University, the Ivy League university in Providence, became need-blind for first-year international applicants from the class entering in 2025: your request for aid does not affect the admission decision. Brown meets the full demonstrated need of admitted students with grant-based aid.

Apply Early Decision (2 Nov 2026) or Regular Decision (early January 2027) and complete the CSS Profile (code 3189) by the aid deadline (RD: 1 Feb 2027). Brown does not accept the ISFAA and does not give CSS fee waivers; applicants from Iran or North Korea should email the aid office for an alternative.
highlights: Open Curriculum with no core requirements
brown-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (ED 1 Nov / RD early January 2027)
Complete the CSS Profile (code 3189) by 2 Nov 2026 (ED) or 1 Feb 2027 (RD)
Upload IDOC documents only if requested by the College Board
brown-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Grant aid meeting full need toward a cost of attendance of roughly US$95,000 a year.

brunel-eu-undergraduate-bursary-2027.about:
Since Brexit, most EU students pay international fees in the UK. Brunel University of London (Uxbridge, west London) offers an EU Undergraduate Bursary of £5,000 for 2027/8 entry to eligible EU students, awarded with no application.

Brunel is known for engineering, design, computer science and sport sciences. Non-EU students should check Brunel's scholarship search for other awards (e.g. school-partner discounts).
highlights: For EU students paying international fees
brunel-eu-undergraduate-bursary-2027.eligibility: EU nationals classed as international fee payers starting an eligible Brunel undergraduate course in 2027/28.
how_to_apply: Apply via UCAS for a Brunel undergraduate course.
Ensure your EU nationality and fee status are recorded.
The bursary is applied automatically.

bryn-mawr-international-aid-2027.about:
Bryn Mawr College near Philadelphia is a selective women's liberal arts college (with cross-registration at Haverford, Swarthmore and Penn). It meets 100% of calculated need for all admitted students; packages combine grants, scholarships, campus jobs and possibly loans. The family contribution stays the same for four years and grants rise with costs.

International students apply for aid only once, at admission: answer 'Yes' to the financial aid intent question on the Common App and file the CSS Profile (code 2049). CSS fee waivers can be requested through the applicant portal.
bryn-mawr-international-aid-2027.eligibility: Women (including trans and nonbinary applicants per college policy) of any nationality applying as first-years and requesting aid at admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (RD) and answer 'Yes' to financial aid intent
Complete the CSS Profile (code 2049) by 15 Jan 2027
Request a CSS fee waiver via the portal by 29 Jan if needed
Submit any extra documents your aid counselor requests
bryn-mawr-international-aid-2027.costs: Grants, scholarships, campus employment and possible loans covering full calculated need.

caltech-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Caltech, the small science and engineering institute in Pasadena, offers need-based financial aid to international students who apply as incoming first-years. Its aid policies for international students are mostly the same as for US students; aid is grant-based institutional funding, since internationals cannot receive US federal aid.

You must indicate on your admission application that you plan to apply for aid; students who do not receive aid in their first year cannot apply later. Apply Restrictive Early Action (1 Nov) or Regular Decision (early January 2027) and follow the international financial aid requirements; priority aid deadlines are 15 Dec 2026 (REA) and 16 Mar 2027 (RD).
highlights: Need-based institutional aid for international first-years
caltech-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years. Not available to transfer or 3/2 applicants. Need-aware admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by early January 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov (REA)
Indicate on the application that you will apply for aid
Submit the CSS Profile and international aid documents by the priority deadline
Receive aid offer with or after the admission decision
caltech-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Institutional grants toward tuition, housing, food and fees based on demonstrated need.

carleton-presidents-welcome-award-intern.about:
Carleton University in Ottawa, Canada's capital, automatically gives the President's Welcome Award (CA$2,000-5,000, unlimited number) to international students entering directly from high school who pay international fees; the amount depends on admission grades. It is added to Carleton's renewable Entrance Scholarship, which goes automatically to students with an admission average of 85% or higher.

Students with 90%+ can additionally apply for Prestige Scholarships (application and reference letter by 1 March). Carleton is strong in public affairs, journalism, international relations, engineering and computer science.
carleton-presidents-welcome-award-intern.eligibility: International fee-paying students entering directly from high school in September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply to Carleton through OUAC
Have all grades sent by 15 June 2027 for entrance-scholarship assessment
Optional: submit Prestige Scholarship application and reference by 1 March 2027
carleton-presidents-welcome-award-intern.costs: Partial: CA$2,000-5,000 welcome award plus renewable entrance scholarship, against tuition of roughly CA$35,000-45,000.
